stripped: Here on the route between the sacred sites of the Observatory and the Faery Ring is a semi-circular clearing.  At its center stands a hut made of lashed branches, roofed with broad leaves.  A certain sect of Elven clerics, who are renowned for their devotion to contemplation, are wont to retire into the solitudes of the woods and groves hereabouts.  They are not, however, renowned for their hospitality.
